## Science

OpenAI has acquired biotechnology startup Orchestra Bio to expand its footprint in the life sciences sector. The startup's team and technology will be integrated with Rosalind, OpenAI's suite of AI models designed for biological research. Backed by investors such as Andreessen Horowitz, the startup builds AI agents that help biotech firms manage complex drug discovery operations. The initiative aims to help scientists accelerate the journey from initial discoveries to patient treatments.

## AI

IBM Research has introduced a new approach called ALTK-Evolve to enhance the performance of customer service AI agents. By analyzing an agent's training attempts and distilling them into behavioral guidelines added to system prompts, the method improves task success rates on customer service benchmarks. This technique enables standard models to achieve higher reliability and policy compliance without requiring any model weight updates.

## Technology

Google, in collaboration with Meta, has open-sourced TorchTPU to provide native PyTorch support for Tensor Processing Units. Announced at the PyTorch Conference, the software stack allows developers to run existing workloads on hardware accelerators with minimal code modifications. This release establishes TPUs as a native option alongside GPUs and CPUs for both model training and deployment.
